Runs a set of ledger backtest tests with fixed ledger, epoch, and config arguments.

# Purpose
This Bash script runs a set of ledger backtest cases by calling `src/flamenco/runtime/tests/run_ledger_backtest.sh` many times with different ledger names, epoch counts, memory limits, end slots, and runtime versions. It acts as a test driver for runtime backtesting across testnet, mainnet, devnet, local cluster, and special boundary cases, so its scope is broad within the backtest test area. The `set -e` command makes the script stop at the first failed backtest, which lets it serve as a batch validation tool for runtime changes. Some entries are commented out, which shows that the file also records test cases that are not active at present.
